messages:
maria: FYI i've opened a docs PR to add a migration guide for customers moving from on‑host PKCS#11 HSM to the new HSM-proxy gateway for Private installs. PR includes a short Go SDK snippet for key wrap/unwarp, network checklist, and an airgapped note. asking for quick reviews :wave:
jon: nice! can you drop the PR link? also where did you put the go snippet — examples/ or sdk/ ?
mar ia: ah typo — PR is #1872, link: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1872. snippet lives under docs/private/migration/examples/go.md — open to moving it.
samir: quick read — we should call out firewall/NAT hairpin for the proxy. in sealed sites the gateway talks to cloud-hsm via outbound TLS on 443 but local HSM traffic is over TCP 15002. add that to port matrix.
ivy: also add note about disabling SO_REUSEPORT on older kernels; we hit weird binds on rhel7 during validation. sysctl snippet: `net.core.somaxconn=1024` + `net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1` might help.
maria: great catches. i'll add ports 443,15002 and sysctl block. any wording suggestions for the airgapped flow? currently says: "copy proxy bundle, import certs, start gateway" which is terse.
jon: expand to step list + checksum validation. show systemd dry-run example. tiny snippet: ```bash
sha256sum redwood-proxy-bundle.tar.gz
sudo tar -xzf redwood-proxy-bundle.tar.gz -C /opt/redwood
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl start redwood-proxy
```
docs-bot: PR 1872 updated by maria — tests: lint/docs ok, linkcheck failed on one internal reference (/ops/hsm-proxy -> /ops/hsm-gateway).
mar ia: thanks bot. i'll fix the link. also adding a short Go example for wrapping a migration key using the SDK:```go
// small example: wrap a migration key before sending to proxy
client := redwood.NewClient("$REDWOOD_KEY")
ctx := context.Background()
plainKey := []byte("customer-key-bytes")
wrapped, err := client.WrapKey(ctx, "migration:wrap", plainKey)
if err != nil {
  log.Fatalf("wrap failed: %v", err)
}
fmt.Printf("wrapped=%x\n", wrapped)
```
jon: 👍 can we also include an example for unwrap on the proxy side (server)? just a 3-line pseudo example so customers can see the flow.
samir: doc lgtm but add a short warning about keeping rotation windows small during migration — we had a case where rotation hit mid-migration and client keys failed.
ivy: +1 on the warning. and add note: if airgapped, ensure time sync before cert validation; include `chronyd` check command.
maria: will add unwrap pseudo, rotation warning, and chrony check. planning to merge Friday unless there are blockers. please react or comment if you want changes. :pray:
jon: i'll do a pass tomorrow morning.
samir: looks good to me.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs PRs touching private/* must include smoke test steps. add a short checklist in the PR description.
maria: added checklist and smoke test commands (conn-check, curl to 127.0.0.1:15002/status). merging after CI. thanks everyone! :tada:
